phenotype: Fit-standardized mean graph-only and hybrid task logits, excluding own task. Supervised source partition must exclude all query scaffolds.
selection: 3 global scaffold folds. Configuration and blend weight chosen without official-valid labels. Leave-one-fold-out selection must improve on average. Fresh source-excluded groups on folds 0 and 1 plus independent chemical-only split if chemical family selected.
limitations: Historical labels repeatedly used. Baseline CV is a historical proxy, not honest full-ensemble OOF. Other-task supervised graph features only use permitted source fitting rows. New feature recipe and search frozen before results. No numerical official-score forecast.
